owner_request: 2026-10-08 继续做环境过滤吧 (Notion #14 sub-task: v3 过滤 - 加市场环境（大趋势方向、波动档）)
question: Within one fixed event set, does the market environment before the shock - BTC's prior trend or its volatility level - separate sync shocks that continue from those that fade, in both periods?
single_variable: Conditioning on the pre-shock environment only: events, outcomes and paired controls are v2's own rows for its loosest config; each event gets a tercile of one environment feature at a time. Data, features, universe, cost, controls and the 2025 split are unchanged.
environment_clock: BTC 1H closes from complete 5m buckets; for an event bar opening at t the last close used is the 1H bar closing at or before t, so the shock bar itself never enters the environment

features.trend30: BTC close / close 720 hours earlier - 1 (primary trend)
features.trend7: BTC close / close 168 hours earlier - 1 (secondary trend)
features.vol30: standard deviation of BTC 1H log returns over the previous 720 hours (volatility level)

bins: terciles per feature, timeframe and side; edges from events before select_before only, frozen and applied to later events

primary.read: top-minus-bottom tercile paired excess per feature in each period; same sign in both periods = the environment orders the outcome

secondary.read: the v3 post-hoc candidate set (30m up shocks), read the same way
